title: AddRoomArea Command
description: Draw a room's area by its corners (AI imports miss rooms): the points become one closed outline on A-ROOM at the floor's height, counterclockwise, a corner given twice counted once. rooms_detect then takes it as the user's word for that region, names it from the labels inside and gives it a plate. With replace, the room given by id, or the one selected, is replaced by the new outline and keeps a type the user set. Refused, with nothing changed: under three corners, under 1 m², or an outline that crosses itself. A shown daylight map is marked out of date.

points.description: The room's corners [x, y] in mm, in order around the room.

replace.description: Replace a room with this outline: the room given by id, else the one selected.

id.description: With replace: the room GUID to replace. Omit to use the one selected room.
